description: This file declares functions related to the 'merge-ort' algorithm, which is a type of three-way merge used in version control systems. It provides wrappers for different merge strategies such as non-recursive, recursive, and generic merge operations.

methods.name: merge_ort_nonrecursive
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge.

methods.name: merge_ort_recursive
methods.description: Performs a recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge with ancestor consolidation.

methods.name: merge_ort_generic
methods.description: Performs a generic, rename-detecting three-way merge, with support for multiple merge bases.
